app.name: Railtally
app.disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made companion app, not affiliated with Days of Wonder.

home.noGames: No games yet. Start your first one!
home.deleteConfirm: Delete this game? This cannot be undone.
home.importFailed: This file is not a Railtally backup.

game.lastRound: Last round! A player has 2 or fewer trains left.
game.endConfirm: End the game and go to the final score?
game.hint: Tap a route to claim it. Press and hold a city for a station.

score.title: Score
score.ticketsNote: Ticket points are secret, so they are not included.

end.title: Final score
end.ticketsHelp: Enter points from completed tickets, minus points from failed ones.
end.expressHelp: Longest continuous path. Calculated automatically; you can change it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacy: Everything stays on this device. Railtally has no accounts and sends no data anywhere; your games are saved only in this browser.
settings.unofficial: Unofficial fan-made app, not affiliated with or endorsed by the publisher of the board game. Game names belong to their owners. The app's code is open source (MIT); the route and ticket data describes the game and is not covered by that license.

errors.twinOwn: A player cannot claim both routes of a double route.
errors.twinBlocked: With 2–3 players only one route of a double route can be used.
errors.stationTaken: This city already has a station.
errors.tooManyMe: Only one player can be you.
errors.ticketMissing: You do not have this ticket.

dataCheck.title: Data check
dataCheck.intro: Compare this list with your physical board. Every route is listed under both of its cities. Report anything that differs.

tickets.title: My tickets
tickets.empty: You have no tickets yet. Add the ones you hold.
tickets.modeStart: Start of game: choose from my 4 tickets
tickets.modeDraw: I drew 3 tickets: choose which to keep
tickets.hint_start: Select the 4 tickets you were dealt: exactly 1 long and 3 short. You must keep at least 2.
tickets.hint_draw: Select the 3 short tickets you drew (long tickets are only dealt at the start). You must keep at least 1.
tickets.mustKeep_one: You must keep at least {{count}} ticket.
tickets.mustKeep_other: You must keep at least {{count}} tickets.
tickets.network: Network: {{trains}} trains to place ({{shared}} shared between tickets) · {{points}} points if all are completed · {{chance}}% chance to complete all.
tickets.tooManyTrains: This needs more trains than you have left.
tickets.note: This is an estimate. It avoids routes opponents have claimed on your map and counts routes you own as free. Each station lets you use one opponent route at its city; a new station costs the 4 points an unused station would give at the end.

why.keepShared: Shares routes with another ticket you keep.
why.keepEfficient: Good points for the trains it needs.
why.dropCostly: Needs many trains for its points.
why.dropRisky: Likely to be blocked before you finish it.
why.keepStation: Works well with a station: it uses an opponent route you can borrow.
why.dropNoTrains: Needs more trains than you have left.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.empty: Add the tickets you hold under My tickets, and the plan appears here.
strategy.noFit: This plan needs more trains than you have left.
strategy.tight: This plan uses {{pct}}% of your remaining trains. There is little room for a detour.
strategy.orderHint: Tap a route to highlight it on the map. Routes that are scarce or contested come first.
strategy.noRoutes: Nothing left to claim. Everything is built or borrowed through stations.
strategy.anyCards: {{n}} of any one color per route
strategy.tunnelWarning: {{n}} tunnel(s) in the plan: keep spare cards, up to 3 extra for each.

reason.noAlternative: no other way if it is taken
reason.costlyDetour: expensive detour if it is taken

strategy.note: This is a heuristic plan, not a guaranteed best. It is recomputed from the map after every change. Routes you own count as done; each station borrows one opponent route.
